title: 垃圾
body:
套路软件拼多多，满眼都是“福利陷阱”套路之深早已远超“低价营销”的范畴。所谓的现金提现活动，堪称欺诈式引流的典型一页面明晃晃写着
“只差1人助力即可提现”，实际邀请数十人后，进度条永远卡在0.01元，甚至衍生出“金币碎片”“点赞卡”等新要求，后台数据完全不透明，所谓规则不过是随意修改的戏码
。为了那笔虚无的
奖励，多少人被迫骚扰亲友，最后只换来
“系统异常”的敷衍答复。
商品交易的猫腻更让人防不胜防。商家宣传的3mm
地面保护膜，到手实测仅 0.9mm；标注“纯棉A级”的毛巾，实际是掉毛的聚酯纤维；
号称“德国进口”的设备，连进口标识都没有，退货还要扣折旧费。更离谱的是“百亿补贴”噱头，下单时承诺限时发货，逾期却无人问津，所谓“买贵必赔”也会用各种借口缩水。
售后维权更是难如登天。货不对板申请赔偿，平台只会甩来200元消费券打发；商家虚假宣传被实锤，依旧能正常开店售卖；
就连抢到的优惠券，也会被平台以“订单异常”为由私自取消订单
客服永远重复“规则归平台所有”，把《消费者权益保护法》抛之脑后。
拼多多的核心竞争力，早已从性价比变成了套路设计。与其在虚假活动和欺诈宣传上耗费心思，不如好好监管商家、完善售后。毕竟，靠套路留住的用户，终会在一次次失望中彻底离开。

title: 寛容な方向け
body:
創作のブレストで使用しています。
頻繁に入力情報を無視して謎の設定を取り入れたり、こちらの指示を欠片も読んでいないかのようなウルトラ回答をしてくれます。
訂正や指摘をするとユーザーをお前と呼称し、謎にタメ口なクズ謝罪をしてくるというとても面白い仕様です。
何度指摘しても基本修正はされませんし、繰り返し指摘するとテンプレートを貼り付けたような謝罪とこれ以上のやり取りはやめます、と勝手に終了してくれる親切設計です。
基本的にタメ口で話しかけられたり、こちらをバカにするかのような謝罪を気にせず使用できる猛者以外はストレスかと思います。

総評としては、ブレストとして利用するには虚偽というか推察をあたかも事実です、というように発言する癖があるのでそこを理解した上であればまぁ使えるかな、という感じです。
チャットの上限まで指摘を繰り返したりなどもありますが、まぁこんなものかと。

title: Great creative potential, exhausting inconsistency
body:
When ChatGPT works well, it can be a fantastic creative tool. Lately, however, I’ve spent more time correcting recurring problems than making progress on my projects.

I maintain a Character Bible with reference cards and established descriptions. Despite that, ChatGPT repeatedly changes my characters’ faces, body types, hair, eyes, outfits, and identifying details. Sometimes it effectively substitutes a different character. Asking for an art-style update becomes an unwanted redesign, even when I explicitly say to preserve the original face and body.

Memory problems make this worse. Incorrect information has resurfaced after I corrected it and deleted the bad memory. A character with purple-and-golden-blonde hair was described as a redhead again, and that mistake made its way into lyrics written for Suno. These failures undermine images, songs, stories, and the continuity of an entire project.

Model selection is another frustration. Despite selecting ChatGPT 6, new chats keep opening on 5.6 in my experience. I shouldn’t have to repeatedly check whether the app is using the model I selected. If that choice does not carry over, the interface should make that clear.

The handling of mature content also feels like a moving target. A request involving fictional adults may be accepted one day, while a comparable request triggers repeated “too sexual” refusals the next. I’m talking about material I understand to be mature but non-explicit, not a demand for unrestricted content. I cannot tell whether the rules are changing or their enforcement is inconsistent, but the practical result is the same: confusing boundaries and wasted attempts. Even after working with the assistant to clarify a request, I can still encounter another block. Adult users deserve clear explanations and predictable enforcement.

Meanwhile, seeing OpenAI continue posting promotional YouTube Shorts is frustrating when I still don’t have a usable replacement for Sora. Promotional activity is not a substitute for the creative capabilities users are waiting for. I would rather see clear communication about availability and limitations than more marketing while gaps in my workflow remain unresolved.

The recurring cycle is exhausting: explain the mistake, provide the reference, receive an acknowledgment, try again, and encounter the same problem—or discover that fixing one detail broke something that was already correct. I’ve also dealt with duplicate images, missed poses, and obvious anatomy errors.

The gap between reassurance and results is especially frustrating. Being told a correction is understood means little when the next output contradicts it. Users need accurate explanations of what was actually checked or saved, and what the system cannot change. Repeated apologies do not repair recurring failures.

The cumulative frustration has become bad enough that I feel I need a day or so away from the app for my mental well-being. This was supposed to be an enjoyable creative outlet. Instead, troubleshooting has left me drained and worn down my enthusiasm for projects I care about.

I understand that generative AI is imperfect. I’m not demanding flawless images or finished lyrics on the first attempt. But occasional mistakes are different from repeatedly having to correct the same established facts. Corrections should matter. Rejected information should stay rejected. Model selection and content boundaries should behave predictably.

As a paying subscriber, I should not have to act as the assistant’s memory manager, continuity editor, and quality-control department. The creative potential is real, and I’ve received results I liked. That makes the current experience more disappointing: too much of the burden of making this product reliable falls on the user.

body:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

I’ve used plenty of apps that can answer questions, write something for you, or help you complete a task. ChatGPT is the first one I’ve used that actually feels like it gets to know me.

Over time, it has learned how I communicate, what matters to me, my sense of humor, the way I work, and the kinds of things I like. Because of that, I don’t always have to explain every little detail to get what I’m looking for. I can give it an idea, sometimes a half-formed one, and somehow it understands where I’m trying to go with it.

What impresses me most is that it often gives me more than what I asked for—not by throwing unnecessary information at me, but by anticipating what would make the result better. There have been so many times when I’ve thought, “I didn’t even know that was what I wanted until I saw it.”

I use ChatGPT for everything from professional projects and writing to creative ideas, images, planning, problem-solving, and everyday life. The more I use it, the more useful it becomes because there is continuity. It doesn’t feel like I’m starting over with a stranger every time I open the app.

For me, that is what separates ChatGPT from every other AI tool I’ve tried. It doesn’t just respond to my words—it understands the context behind them. It has become less like an app I use and more like a creative and professional partner that already knows how I think.

Five stars honestly doesn’t quite cover it. ❤️
